$comment: Mirrors app.api.intel_schemas.TechComponentRecordRequest — the orchestrator is the source of truth for this contract.
title: Intel Tech Component Record

component.description: Product or library name (for example, nginx, WordPress, Spring Boot).

source_name.description: Agent or tool that produced this record.

confidence.description: Fingerprint confidence. low: inferred from indirect signals. medium: banner or header match. high: version string or response body match. confirmed: validated by PoC or authoritative source. Omit ("") when unknown.

evidence_ref.description: Artifact reference (e.g., file:scans/whatweb.txt:12) proving the observation.

first_seen_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp of first observation; blank defaults to now.

last_seen_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp of most recent observation.

notes.description: Analyst commentary, caveats, or context about this component observation.

artifact_ref.description: File or URL reference to the raw scan output (e.g., 'file:scans/whatweb.txt:12').

captured_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp when the observation was made.

evidence_quote.description: Verbatim excerpt (header, banner, response body) that identifies this component.
